## Roadmap binding
- Level-1: CROSS-CUTTING / RSI canonical repair
- Level-2: Phase36 exploration exposure effect
- Stacked on: #906 held-skill post-admission freshness/retention gate
- Branch fork: work/browser-final-2026-convergence-rsi-phase36-held-credit-freshness-gate-v1-sol

## Purpose
Advance the existing Phase36 PREPARED -> ATTEMPTED release journal into exactly one bounded DORMANT_CAP -> EXPLORATION_ACTIVE exposure effect, without granting full activation or a retry loop.

## Contract
- ATTEMPTED remains a durable pre-effect fence.
- A second exact current-state readback occurs after ATTEMPTED is persisted and before any hold mutation.
- If the exact predecessor is no longer present but the hold remains, the attempt terminates as CONFIRMED_NOT_RELEASED_NEW_ATTEMPT_REQUIRED with no effect.
- If state is ambiguous, transition to RECONCILIATION_ONLY; no effect is repeated.
- On exact predecessor, only the target admission exposure hold is removed.
- The resulting governance must exactly equal the precommitted next governance and the target must be EXPLORATION_ACTIVE.
- Hold mutation + terminal CONFIRMED_RELEASED_EXPLORATION_ONLY attempt state are persisted in one atomic lifecycle image (temp + fsync + rename).
- Persistence failures rollback in-memory hold/attempt state.
- Independent readback-only reconciliation can prove released, prove no effect/new attempt, or remain reconciliation-only, and performs zero additional effects.
- Readback owner is separated from release/evaluator/admission/effect principals.
- Full ACTIVE promotion remains forbidden.

## Regression
The Phase34B/36 integration path now exercises PREPARED -> ATTEMPTED -> one-attempt effect -> CONFIRMED_RELEASED_EXPLORATION_ONLY, proves exactly one effect attempt, no same-effect retry, hold count 0, EXPLORATION_ACTIVE activation view, terminal transition history, and idempotent external readback.

Draft/source-only. No production/live Browser effect, no promotion, and no self-update.

- Exact head: `dfe27e16365fe15c266d318ba21140d076cccc30`

## Why

PR #882 hardens the trusted-base governance verifier, but workflow correctness is not the same as repository-side merge enforcement. GitHub's required status checks/rulesets are the mechanism that actually rejects a merge when the check is absent or failing.

Live readback currently shows `main` protected but no required status-check contexts in the branch summary, and the only repository ruleset observed (`w1-persistent-host-proof`, id 21216667) is disabled. This PR therefore keeps R4 fail-closed instead of treating a green workflow as proof of physical enforcement.

## Implementation

- Add pure `metaengine.rsi.physical-merge-gate.v1` classifier.
- Freeze repository `PatrickFrome/Compute`, target `refs/heads/main`, and authoritative check context `governance`.
- Accept physical-gate proof only from a required branch-protection context or an Active main-targeting ruleset.
- Disabled and wrong-target rulesets never count.
- Ruleset bypass actors / current-user always-bypass prevent an absolute-enforcement claim.
- Workflow success alone is explicitly insufficient.
- No repository administration mutation is performed.

## Tests

10 focused regressions cover branch-protection positive proof, active ruleset positive proof, disabled ruleset, workflow-only evidence, wrong target, bypass actors, current-user bypass, unprotected main, frozen check name and zero-authority trust root.

Exact source readback caught and corrected the repo-root import path before qualification.

`research/RSI_R4C_PHYSICAL_MERGE_GATE_RESEARCH_2026-09-19.md` maps GitHub required-check semantics, SLSA Source technical controls, harness-tampering work, Self-Harness and in-toto into the R4 proof boundary.

Read-only evidence contract only. Browser/task/execution/scheduler/promotion/self-update/production-mutation authority are false. This PR cannot create or activate a ruleset.

Draft only. The classifier must pass exact-head CI. body:
## Phase35 selective convergence

Stacked on canonical repair PR #836. This ports the strongest Phase35 semantics into the existing Phase34B lifecycle without importing the donor's parallel append/lifecycle plane.

### 1. Proven pre-effect drift becomes terminal no-effect
After durable `ATTEMPTED`, the lifecycle re-reads exact predecessor library + governance immediately before storage append. Drift is persisted as `PRE_EFFECT_DRIFT_NO_EFFECT` with `effect_started=false`, `effect_not_started_proven=true`, no same-effect retry, and a fresh externally authorized attempt required.

### 2. Storage admission now creates an explicit exposure hold
A successful Phase34B append persists the new skill digest in the existing lifecycle's durable exposure-hold set. Governance excludes held skills from ACTIVE/EXPLORATION selection even if positive lifecycle evidence later arrives. Reconciliation of an externally observed successor also installs the hold before confirming the storage-only effect.

### 3. Safety terminal states remain visible
A hold blocks activation, but QUARANTINED/RETIRED remains stronger than DORMANT so harmful evidence is not hidden by the exposure hold.

### 4. Backward compatibility
Current governance objects carry and verify the new hold contract. Historical v1 governance objects without the hold extension remain verifiable so old durable admission evidence is not made unreadable by the upgrade.

No Browser/task/scheduler/promotion/self-update authority is added. No second lifecycle, scheduler, evaluator, CAS append plane, or retry loop is created. The hold has no release API in this PR; external bounded release remains Phase36.

Draft until canonical PR #836 is terminal-green and this exact stacked head is independently qualified.
